subject: Supplier portal: SSO handback timeout causing login drops - BlueCoral
messages:
From: Alexandra Rios <alex@bluecoral.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueCoral IT <it-support@bluecoral.com>
Date: 2026-06-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier portal invite - login keeps dropping

Hi Jordan,

We tried accepting the supplier invite this morning but our users are hitting a login loop: after SSO they land back on the invitation page with an error toast. Happens across Chrome and Edge. Attached is a short server-side session trace and a screenshot of the error.

Can you confirm if this is a known issue or if anything on your end needs reconfiguration? We've got a PO pending and the procurement team is blocked.

Thanks,
Alex Rios
Head of Procurement Operations
BlueCoral Design Co.

Attachments:
- bluecoral-session-trace.txt (text)
- sso-screenshot.png (image)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Rios <alex@bluecoral.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-06T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier portal invite - login keeps dropping

Hi Alex — thanks for the trace and screenshot. Sorry you're stuck here. Quick notes:

- I can reproduce a similar flow in staging where the SSO handback takes ~6–8s and the invite accept request times out at our edge, triggering a redirect loop.
- Ben, can you look at the edge timeout config and the retry window for the accept handler?

Workaround for BlueCoral until we patch: share a one-time direct activation link (expires in 24h) that bypasses the accept round-trip. Alex — would you like me to generate that now?

Jordan
Director, Partner Onboarding
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-06T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier portal invite - login keeps dropping

Forwarded message:
> From: infra-edge@redwood.com
> Date: 2026-06-06T09:58:32-07:00
> Subject: Edge latency spike correlated with outbound SSO post
>
> Observed a short window (09:42–09:59 PDT) of elevated p95 egress latency to the external IdP cluster. Several accept-token POSTs retried and then returned 502 from our acceptor until the cluster recovered. Recommend bumping accept timeout to 12s and adding a single retry with jitter.
>
I've opened a quick fix ticket (JIRA:PROC-4321) and will deploy the timeout bump to staging in the next 30 mins, then prod after validation. I'll also enable a short-lived override so Jordan can issue the direct activation link if Alex wants it immediately.

Ben
Onboarding Ops
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Rios <alex@bluecoral.com>, BlueCoral IT <it-support@bluecoral.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Supplier portal invite - login keeps dropping

Alex — quick update and next steps: 

1) Root cause: transient edge egress latency to your Identity Provider cluster caused our accept-token POST to time out and redirect the user back to the invite flow. The token was still valid, but the accept endpoint never finished the handshake before the browser redirected.

2) Immediate actions we took:
- Increased accept timeout from 6s to 12s for the edge acceptor (rolled to prod at 15:12 PDT).
- Enabled a one-time direct activation link for BlueCoral (expires 2026-06-08 15:12 PDT). Link was emailed to alex@bluecoral.com separately.
- Logged the session traces and attached them to JIRA:PROC-4321 for follow-up.

3) Requests for you:
- Please try the direct link and confirm account acceptance.
- If anyone still sees the loop, send the browser console log and the exact timestamp so we can correlate.

I'll keep the thread open until you're green. Appreciate the quick repro steps and traces — they helped us pinpoint the window.

Best,
Jordan
Director, Partner Onboarding
Redwood Inference
